acceptanceCriteria: a Go test whose filepath.Glob literal matches a changed or added path is selected with a witness naming the glob
non-literal glob patterns stay UNKNOWN, never silently excluded
regression fixture: adding a .github/workflows file selects a package whose test globs that directory
body: Observed 2026-10-18 on PR beamfall/corvint#1100. The lane added .github/workflows/spec-toolchain-conformance.yml. cmd/corvint TestGoOnlySourceAndVersion (GOC-V0-001) globs .github/workflows/*.y*ml and failed in CI (go-product-shard 0, run 39146348422) because the workflow comment contained 'PyPI'. `corvint affected --base <merge-base>` listed the workflow only as UNOWNED_DIRTY_PATH. cmd/corvint was selected, but only through an unrelated source change (cmd/corvint/affected.go). Nothing linked the new file to the test that reads it, so a lane without that coincidental selection would skip the test locally. Expected: a static filepath.Glob/os.ReadDir pattern over a repo-relative literal path in a Go test becomes a data-read edge, so adding or changing a matching file selects that package with a witness naming the pattern. Unresolvable patterns stay UNKNOWN.
title: affected: a Go test that reads files through filepath.Glob is not selected when a matching file is added; the new file is only an UNOWNED_DIRTY_PATH unknown
